final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, COUNT(DISTINCT q.arcref) AS project_count FROM scanqc AS q JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(project_count) AS total_count FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.funding_source, s1.project_count, 1.0 * s1.project_count / NULLIF(s2.total_count, 0) AS share FROM step1 AS s1 CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2 WHERE s2.total_count IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(project_count) AS average_count FROM step3) SELECT s3.funding_source, s3.project_count, s3.share, 1.0 * s3.project_count / NULLIF(s4.average_count, 0) FROM step3 AS s3 CROSS JOIN step4 AS s4 WHERE s4.average_count IS NOT NULL
